main_text.head: ET CAPITUM.
SECT. IV. CAP. II.
main_text.l: 6. Traduntur regulæ in statutis personalibus observandæ.
7. Nullum statutum sive reale, sive personale, se extendit extra territorium.
9. Statutum se extendit extra territorium, si utrumque subsit uni supremo Principi.
10. Pœna subdito statuto imponi poterit propter gesta extra territorium.
11. Etiam collectæ imponuntur subdito ratione bonorum extra territorium.
12. Statutum prohibens ne frumentum exportetur etiam obligat forensem.
13. Etiam statutum obligat forensem, si consentiat.
14. Si sit actus voluntariæ jurisdictionis exercendus.
16. Bona statuto loci communia, etiam quæ alibi sita ubi contrarium statutum, ex pacto communicanda.
17. Statutum loci extra territorium, ex comitate & æquitate sæpe servatur.

page.notes: The list is printed in italic type with the numbers in roman. Line 16 reads "alibi sita ubi contrarium statutum" as printed; the sense is unclear. Scan is faint in places; the watermark "Digitized by Google" is omitted.
